name: QuickBooks Payments

evidence.gateway: F02: Intuit collects the seller's card payments as the seller's payment agent
evidence.billing: F14: US Recurring Payments with customer-authorized scheduled charges; F15: schedule and cancel
evidence.links: F16: US hosted payment links shared by email, text, QR code or social, no code needed

line: Accept payments and send invoices from QuickBooks with card and bank methods.

free.text: US Free: 2 invoices/month; unlimited after Payments approval

cells.payout: First up to 5 days; later US 1 day, Canada/UK cards 2 days

fee.math: The standard rate for cards paid through an online invoice. Keyed-in cards and API payments have different rates.
VAT at 20% is added to the fee. A QuickBooks Online subscription is needed separately.
Seller offers are only for the US, Canada and UK. Germany isn't a supported sign-up country.
